sloka: काले काले तु धर्मात्मा पुष्पकेण धनेश्वरः ।अभ्यागच्छद्विनीतात्मा पितरं मातरं च हि ।। ७.३.३५ ॥
transliteration: kāle kāle tu dharmātmā puṣpakeṇa dhaneśvaraḥ ।abhyāgacchadvinītātmā pitaraṁ mātaraṁ ca hi ।। 7.3.35 ॥

translations.english: The righteous and humble Kubera, the lord of wealth, used to visit his father and mother from time to time in his Pushpaka chariot.
